assertion_results.text: Bug parsing extracts the Environment / Version section content including the vague text (Step 1)
assertion_results.evidence: In bug-parsing.md, the Environment / Version section is listed as Present in the Required Sections table (line 26) and its content is extracted under 'Parsed Section Contents' at lines 61-62: '### Environment / Version\nNot sure which version -- using whatever is deployed on staging.' The vague text is fully captured.

assertion_results.text: Version resolution determines that no version identifier can be extracted from the vague description (Step 4.5.2)
assertion_results.evidence: In version-resolution.md, section '4.5.2 -- Extract Version from Description' (lines 9-23) quotes the vague text, performs extraction analysis searching for explicit version numbers, product-prefixed versions, and version keywords, and concludes: 'The section contains only vague text ("Not sure which version", "whatever is deployed on staging"). No version pattern can be extracted from this text.' Result stated as: 'No version identifier could be extracted. Skipping to sub-step 4.5.6 (gap flagging).'

assertion_results.text: Version resolution outputs the gap comment: 'Affects Version could not be determined from the bug description — please set manually.' (Step 4.5.6)
assertion_results.evidence: In version-resolution.md, section '4.5.6 -- Flag Gap' (lines 29-35) states 'Version information cannot be extracted from the description. Posting gap comment on ACME-511.' and shows the posted comment text: 'Affects Version could not be determined from the bug description -- please set manually.' (double-hyphen is the ASCII representation of the em dash in the assertion).

assertion_results.text: The gap comment includes the Comment Footnote (Step 4.5.6)
assertion_results.evidence: In version-resolution.md, the gap comment (lines 35-38) is followed by a horizontal rule and the footnote: 'This comment was AI-generated by [sdlc-workflow/triage-bug](https://github.com/RHEcosystemAppEng/sdlc-plugins) v0.13.7.' This matches the Comment Footnote pattern also seen in root-cause.md line 60.
